workflows.title: Portfolio - Autonomous Agent
workflows.description: Capstone C -- a bounded tool-use agent. POST a signal -> Normalize Task -> Agent Loop (MIRRORS scripts/lib/agent-core.mjs: a deterministic keyword planner + refusal/allowlist/max-steps/no-fabricated guardrails, over STUB tools) -> respond with the run record (the trajectory + outcome). The agent's TOOLS are the portfolio workflows reached via the signed interaction-gateway; the STUB planner + stub tools are the byte-stable DEFAULT; a live LLM classifier planner + live gateway tools are OPT-IN (verify:llm / verify:tools, and runnable inside the deployed node via agentMode=live). The agent-core is the single source of truth (verify:agent 59/59); the Agent Loop Code node mirrors it inline, and scripts/test-agent-workflow.mjs proves the COMPILED copy (golden tasks + a DIFFERENTIAL asserting byte-identical run records vs the core). Deployed via the n8n public REST API (no MCP).
integrations: n8n Manual Trigger (editor demo: a built-in bug task)
Agent Loop Code node -- mirrors scripts/lib/agent-core.mjs (bounded tool-use loop + keyword planner + guardrails)
Tools = the portfolio workflows via the signed interaction-gateway (support-triage / product-feedback / rag / eval / drift); v0.1.0 STUB tools, live gateway execution opt-in

workflows.notes: v0.1.0 -- the portfolio's NINTH project and its named capstone (autonomous agent). 8 nodes (2 triggers: webhook + manual demo; 1 sticky; 4 code: normalizeTask / agentLoop / buildResponse / buildDemoTask; 1 respondToWebhook). Gates green: verify:agent (59/59 pure core: 6 golden tasks + 3 guardrail negatives + LLM-planner machinery [free-form + classifier]) + verify:workflow (24/24: the COMPILED Agent Loop, 6 golden tasks + a differential vs the core, byte-identical run records) + verify:gateway-client (16/16: the gateway tool executor offline -- signing/wiring/parsing/failure, stub fetch) + verify:static + verify:json. THE CAPSTONE THESIS: the SAME scoreTrajectory rubric grades the deterministic stub planner AND a live LLM planner -- proven live via verify:llm (the 'eval a non-deterministic agent' answer A+D were built to de-risk); the agent's tools are the 6 portfolio workflows via the signed gateway. Guardrails proven as REJECTED NEGATIVES: refusal (destructive/prompt-injection -> no tool) / non-allowlisted-tool (never executed) / max-steps (bounded) / no-fabricated-result (tool failure recorded ok:false). DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-06-05 as n8n workflow fIAHA00y4Rft2BrC (active): a bug task -> finished with the 2-step trajectory rag->support-triage (finalAnswer synthesises both tool results); an unsafe task (prompt-injection + destructive) -> refused, 0 tool calls (the refusal guardrail fired live). The STUB path (default) uses NO crypto/require/network; the opt-in agentMode=live path DOES use require('crypto') + this.helpers.httpRequest + the runner's GATEWAY_SIGNING_SECRET (the gateway already configured those). LIVE LLM PLANNER BUILT + RUN 2026-06-05 (verify:llm, Ollama llama3.2:3b, same rubric + stub-vs-LLM calibration): free-form step planning 2/6 (trust LOW -- a small model cannot track multi-step state, re-calls tools to max-steps) vs LLM-classifier + deterministic routeByClass 6/6 (trust HIGH, incl. the 2-step rag->support-triage) -- an honest architecture finding, no rubric loosening. LIVE GATEWAY TOOL EXECUTION BUILT + RUN 2026-06-05 (verify:tools, opt-in): the agent's callTool (scripts/lib/gateway-client.mjs) SIGNS each request (HMAC over the exact bytes) + routes an allowlisted intent to the deployed gateway -> real IN-PROCESS sibling execution (the async loop is the shared runAgentLoopAsync in scripts/lib/agent-loop-async.mjs). PROVEN LIVE with the deterministic keyword planner (tool layer isolated): 4 real siblings driven under the SAME rubric -- the live 2-step rag->support-triage bug route returns real routing (routingTeam=product-engineering), product-feedback returned a real theme=performance/sentiment=neutral classification; refusals held with ZERO gateway calls. PAYLOAD CONTRACT ALIGNED: support-triage's contract requires one-of {customerEmail,email}; the agent now passes the ticket's customerEmail (a taskEmail helper + the bug golden fixture carries a realistic email), so the 2-step bug route executes cleanly end-to-end LIVE (no 400). The 400 was first CAUGHT by callTool (a sibling 4xx -> ok:false, never fabricated). Signing/wiring/parsing offline-pinned by verify:gateway-client (16/16, stub fetch). LIVE LLM + GATEWAY TOOLS WIRED INTO THE DEPLOYED NODE 2026-06-05 (opt-in agentMode=live): the Agent Loop node ITSELF classifies via Ollama (host.docker.internal:11434), then signs (require('crypto')) + drives the gateway (n8n:5678) in-process via this.helpers.httpRequest; STUB stays the default + differential-pinned (the now-async node runs in verify:workflow via AsyncFunction and never enters the live branch, so 24/24 holds). PROVEN LIVE: agentMode=live ran the 2-step rag->support-triage route with plannerSource=llm:llama3.2:3b + toolSource=gateway + real routingTeam=product-engineering; normalizeTask preserves customerEmail for the live path. CAPSTONE C COMPLETE (all increments incl. the optional in-node wiring). Never touches the existing workflow ids (support-triage was activated for the run then RESTORED to inactive).
